assets.prompt:
Use case: game-asset. Asset type: one production sprite atlas for an original fantasy mobile tower defense game. Create a single transparent-background texture with EXACTLY SIX separate full-body enemy sprites in a strict 3-column by 2-row equal-cell grid. All cells have generous clear margins; nothing overlaps cell borders. NO grid lines, NO labels, NO text, NO ground scenery, NO baked shadow. Front-facing downscreen characters viewed from an elevated three-quarter game camera, matching the same orthographic camera, lighting and scale convention. High-end hand-painted 2D fantasy tower defense art: very clear expressive silhouettes, chunky appealing proportions, bold dark brown outlines, sculpted painted highlights, restrained material detail readable at 60 pixels, original character designs. Warm upper-left key light, subtle cool rim on right.
Cell order left to right, top to bottom:
1. goblin worker: short green goblin, big angular ears, mischievous fanged face, brown leather belt and loincloth, simple heavy wooden club held beside body.
2. goblin stone slinger: small olive-green goblin, red-brown scarf, brown leather stone pouch and sling weapon, obvious different silhouette.
3. goblin shaman healer: blue-green goblin in dark plum robe, elaborate small bone mask and antler totem staff, mint magic gemstone, clear shaman silhouette.
4. wolf rider: green goblin riding stocky gray wolf viewed from front-three-quarter, broad wolf head visible, red saddle cloth, feet fully visible.
5. elite goblin brute: massive muscular green goblin with one iron pauldron, brown straps, oversized heavy wooden mallet, very wide intimidating silhouette.
6. goblin king boss: thick green goblin king in gold crown, red cape, bronze armor and broad war axe, king silhouette.
Each sprite stands facing screen-bottom, feet fully visible. Natural grounded poses with readable arms and weapons. Clear opaque character pixels with clean true alpha outside. Keep no haze around characters. Aim for the visual richness and readability of premium classic hand-painted fantasy tower defense games.

Use case: game-asset. Asset type: a SINGLE production hero animation sprite atlas for an original fantasy hand-painted tower defense game. TRUE TRANSPARENT background.
Strict layout: EXACTLY FIVE equal columns and TWO equal rows. Ten isolated full-body sprites total. Every sprite occupies no more than 80 percent of its cell width and 85 percent cell height, generous transparent padding, weapons entirely within its cell, never cross any cell border. No grid lines, no labels or letters, no ground, no cast shadows, no UI, no floating effects.
Camera: elevated orthographic three-quarter REAR view. ALL heroes face screen TOP to fight enemies approaching from top; we see their backs, cloaks and hair, NOT front portraits. Feet fully visible. Thick clean dark-brown contour; painterly chunky sculpted volumes; rich controlled material colors; original premium fantasy tower defense character designs, readable at 110 pixel screen height. Upper-left warm key light with cool edge highlights.
Columns, same identity in both rows:
1. female blonde elf archer with leaf-green cloak, leather armor and elegant wooden bow.
2. male ranger with short dark hair under a dark navy hood, navy cloak, leather shoulder armor and large steel crossbow.
3. red-haired male fire mage with rusty red and ember-orange robe, short ornate staff with orange gemstone.
4. silver-haired male lightning mage with deep violet robe, silver trim and staff tipped with small purple crystal.
5. female ice mage with long ice-blue white hair, turquoise and sapphire robe, white fur shoulders and staff topped with a faceted ice crystal.
Top row: idle combat-ready rear poses, weapon in hand, relaxed grounded stance.
Bottom row: corresponding ATTACK poses of exactly those same five heroes, same scale, outfit and feet baseline. Archer drawing bow to shoot toward screen top, ranger bracing aiming crossbow toward top, three mages leaning slightly forward holding staff to cast toward top. No giant glow: emphasize actual readable body/arm pose changes. Keep colors and identity identical across frames. Use entire atlas with clean alpha outside each silhouette.
